units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 2:9">Targ. Ps. II, 9</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 11:33">Targ. Lev. XI, 33</cite>; a. fr. (interch. with <cite ref="M00048"><he>מָן</he></cite>, <cite ref="M01696"><he>מַן</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 17b:19">B. Kam. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ תבירא תבר</he> it was a broken vessel he broke.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 17b:21">Ib.</cite> <he>בתר תבר מ׳ אזלינן</he> we judge by the final cause by which the vessel was broken; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>מָאנִין</he>, <he>מָאנַיָּא</he>, <cite ref="M01771"><he>מָאנֵי</he></cite>, <cite ref="M00539"><he>מָנ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 11:2">Targ. Ex. XI, 2</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 105b:12">Sabb. 105ᵇ</cite> <he>תבר מ׳ תבירי</he> broke broken vessels (pretending to be angry); a. fr.

senses.gloss: (cmp. כֶּלִי) garment, dress. Ib. 113ᵇ; Snh. 94ᵃ קרי למָאנֵיה וכ׳ called his dress (garments) &c., v. כָּבֵד I; B. Kam. 91ᵇ למאני (corr. acc.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.).—
units: B. Mets. 47ᵃ במ׳ דכשר למקני ביה (symbolical possession has been given) by means of a garment fit for the purpose; a. fr.—Pl. as ab.
